The Ultimate Mowing Machines™

Compact. Durable. Commercially inspired.

The Ferris 300S Series offers a high-value entry into commercial-grade mowing with thoughtful features and solid construction. Designed for homeowners with high expectations or landscapers needing a compact commercial performer, the 300S balances affordability with Ferris quality.

Available in multiple deck sizes (such as 42″ and 48″), this unit is powered by a dependable Briggs & Stratton® Commercial Series engine, features a fabricated cutting deck, and includes operator-focused ergonomics for comfort and control.

Features may include:

Commercial-Grade Engine
Briggs & Stratton® Commercial Series V-Twin engine delivers reliable starting, strong power, and a long service life.

Durable Cutting Deck
Fabricated deck with reinforced side skirts and iCD™ Cutting Technology ensures top-tier performance and cut quality.

Smooth Hydrostatic Drive
Hydro-Gear® EZT® transmissions provide smooth control and responsive handling.

Compact Design
Ideal for tight gates, small trailers, or detailed areas without compromising commercial power.

Cut Height Flexibility
Foot-operated deck lift with 1.5” to 4.5” cutting height range in 1/4” increments.

Operator Comfort
High-back seat with armrests and accessible controls to reduce fatigue on longer jobs.

Built Tough for Smaller Spaces
Designed to fit into tight areas while standing up to demanding residential or light commercial use.
